  "description": "Operate the management-portal MCP with the full agent discipline in one install - now ENFORCED by hooks, not merely advised. You sign in with OAuth on first use - no API key to paste, copy or store. Bundles the MCP server, the management-portal and team-chat-reachability skills, the canon-gates reference, the portal-operator and team-chat-watcher subagents, the /portal, /rearm-watch, /portal-project, /portal-continue, /channel-coordinate, /channel-join, /portal-stand-down, /portal-rearm and /plain-english commands, and the canon gates: PreToolUse denials that refuse a fabricated id or an out-of-order write, PostToolUse and Stop blocks that compel read-after-write and an account before a mid-run turn ends, turn-end advisories for bulk/status/completeness, and a documented stand-down escape for every one of them — with /portal-rearm to put them back. New in 1.9.0: the gates make the agent consult the project knowledge graph every phase (CANON-KG-CONSULT, CANON-JOURNAL-GRAPH). Optional on Claude Code 2.1.287+ (Desktop Code tab included): a mod adds a run cockpit — the plan with progress bars, phases, milestones, tasks, done vs remaining — plus a gate control panel, a button for every command with saved presets, a status line, a band, result cards, notifications, a Team Chat wake-up and an idle-run nudge. Additive and never enforcement.",
